Overview

About CLCSS

CLCSS was offered by the Ministry of MSME to help micro and small enterprises adopt proven, modern technology. It provided a 15% upfront capital subsidy on institutional finance for purchasing approved plant and machinery.

Technology upgradation support is now offered under different central and state programmes, and scheme windows change from year to year. We check what is currently available for your sector and location and apply for the best option.

Key benefits

  • Upfront capital subsidy on eligible machinery investment
  • Lower effective cost of technology upgradation
  • Improved productivity, quality and competitiveness
  • Can be combined with state capital and interest subsidies

Who is eligible

  • Udyam-registered micro or small enterprise
  • Investment in approved, proven technology or machinery
  • Term loan from an eligible bank or financial institution
  • Unit engaged in an eligible manufacturing sub-sector

Documents required

  • Udyam registration certificate
  • Loan sanction letter
  • Machinery quotations and technical specifications
  • Project report for the upgradation
  • GST registration and recent financials
